scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Welcome to
the Royal Dragon,
where you can find the
finest accomodations
and the best service.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
欢迎光临皇家龙酒店，这里为您提供一流的住宿和最优质的服务。

scripts.text: Save Point
scripts.translation: 保存复活点

scripts.text: Rest - 5,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 - 5,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you, your
Respawn Point has
been saved here in
the Royal Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
谢谢，您的复活点已保存于皇家龙酒店。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
I'm sorry, but
you need 5,000 zeny
in order to check in.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
很抱歉，入住需要5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you~
I hope you enjoy
your stay in the
Royal Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
谢谢~
祝您在皇家龙酒店住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
谢谢，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Good day~
Welcome to the
most comfortable
inn here in Veins~
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
您好~欢迎光临伯仁斯最舒适的旅店~

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 保存

scripts.text: Take a Rest -> 5000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 -> 5000 Zeny

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved in Veins.
Enjoy your stay in town~
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
您的复活点已保存于伯仁斯。
祝您在城里度过愉快的时光~

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think you have enough
money to check in. The
service charge is 5,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
很抱歉，您的钱好像不够入住，费用是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Enjoy your stay~
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
祝您住得愉快~

scripts.text:
[Inn Master]
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[旅店主人]
请再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Welcome to the beautiful Brasilis Hotel.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老板]
欢迎光临美丽的巴西酒店。

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 保存

scripts.text: Rest -5000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 - 5000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Do you want to save here at the Brasilis Hotel?
scripts.translation:
[酒店老板]
要在巴西酒店保存复活点吗？

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text: Absolutely.
scripts.translation: 当然要

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Ok then, enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老板]
好，祝您住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
Your respawn has been saved here at the hotel. I hope that you enjoy your stay here in Brasilis.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老板]
您的复活点已保存于酒店。
祝您在巴西度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
I will show you a great room.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老板]
我带您去一间很不错的客房。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Keeper]
I'm sorry, but the service charge is 5,000 zeny per night.
scripts.translation:
[酒店老板]
很抱歉，每晚的服务费是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Good day, welcome to the
Einbroch Hotel. The staff is
always striving to accommodate
our guests with the highest
standards in cleanliness,
service and convenience~
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
您好，欢迎光临艾音布罗克酒店。
我们始终致力于提供最高标准的清洁、服务与便利，让客人住得舒心~

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Are you looking
for Mr. Defru Ark?
Oh right, he did mention
waiting for some package
from the Airport. Now let
me pull up that information...
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
您在找德弗鲁·阿克先生吗？
对了，他说过正在等机场送来的包裹。
让我查一下...

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Ah, here we are.
Mr. Defru Ark is
staying in Room 201.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
找到了，德弗鲁·阿克先生住在201号房。

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 保存

scripts.text: Take Rest - 5,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 休息 - 5,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
in the Einbroch Hotel.
Thank you, and please
come again.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
您的复活点已保存于艾音布罗克酒店。
谢谢，欢迎再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you.
Please enjoy
your rest~
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
谢谢。
祝您休息愉快~

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
accommodation fee is
5,000 zeny. Next time,
please make sure that you
bring enough zeny, okay?
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
很抱歉，住宿费是5,000 Zeny。
下次请确保携带足够的Zeny，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Thank you and
please come again~
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
谢谢，欢迎再次光临~

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
祝您有美好的一天。
